An Abu Dhabi-headquartered developer founded in 2014, building apartment and community projects on Reem, Yas and Saadiyat islands and in Masdar City, with a growing international footprint.

Profile

Reportage Group, also known as Reportage Properties, is a real estate developer founded in 2014 and headquartered in Abu Dhabi. It builds both residential apartment buildings and residential communities, and has expanded from its home market into a wide range of countries; its website currently lists 19, spanning the Gulf, Africa, Europe, Asia and the United States.

In Abu Dhabi, the company has concentrated on the capital's main growth districts. Its work includes high-rise residences on Al Reem Island, canal-side projects in the Yas Bay area of Yas Island, low-rise sustainable buildings in Masdar City and a newer development on Saadiyat Island. The portfolio is presented in two lines, residential apartments and residential communities, and the group also markets projects elsewhere in the UAE, including Dubai and Fujairah, as well as in Riyadh. Taken together, its Abu Dhabi projects lean towards mid-rise and high-rise apartment living in established island and sustainability-led districts.

Key areas of activity

  • Residential apartment buildings
  • Residential communities
  • Masdar City sustainable housing
